description:
Autex Acoustic Timber Panel is a high-performance acoustic treatment designed
to realistically imitate timber. Formed from thermally bonded high-density
polyester using a 25mm Quietspace Panel base, it features woodgrain textures
taken from real timber veneers digitally printed onto the panel surface with
safe, water-based UV-cured ink. It delivers an authentic timber aesthetic while
meeting strict seismic requirements and Group 1 fire compliance across wall and
ceiling applications.

rag_summary:
Autex Acoustic Timber - Quietspace is a 25mm thick,
high-performance acoustic wall and ceiling panel that realistically replicates
natural timber grain. Constructed from thermally bonded 100% polyester fibres on
a dual-density Quietspace Panel base, high-resolution woodgrains are digitally
printed using safe, water-based UV-cured ink without reducing acoustic
absorption. Delivering an outstanding NRC of 0.85, Group 1 fire classification,
and carbon-neutral certification, it replaces heavy, resonant timber panelling
with a lightweight, seismic-compliant solution that eliminates interior
reverberation.

description:

to provide thermal and acoustic performance in residential and commercial
buildings. Manufactured from thermally bonded polyester fibre without chemical

without protective gear. Pre-cut to fit common timber and steel framed walls,
ceilings, and mid-floor cavities, they will not settle, crumble, or slump over
their 50-year durability life.

rag_summary:
Autex GreenStuf Batts (Autex Batt) are non-toxic, itch-free
thermal and acoustic insulation segments manufactured in Australia and New
Zealand from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibre with recycled PET content.
Pre-cut to 430mm and 580mm widths for standard stud and joist spacings, they
deliver thermal ratings from R1.5 to R4.0 and boost wall acoustic isolation by 5
to 6 Rw points. Free from chemical binders, asbestos, and respirable fibres,
they are safe to handle without protective gear, resistant to moisture and
vermin, and backed by an industry-leading 50-year durability warranty.
